title: A Day in the 1461 Grand Bazaar
hook: With 4,000 shops under covered vaulted ceilings, Istanbul ruled world trade.

scenes.text: Commissioned by Sultan Mehmed II in 1461, Istanbul's Grand Bazaar became the largest covered shopping market on planet Earth.
scenes.imagePrompt: Grand vaulted stone archway entrance to Istanbul's covered Grand Bazaar adorned with calligraphic gold inscriptions and tilework. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Commissioned by Sultan Mehmed II in 1461, Istanbul's Grand Bazaar became the largest covered shopping market on planet Earth.

scenes.text: Over four thousand shops lined sixty-four covered streets, where shafts of sunlight poured through high domed ceiling oculi.
scenes.imagePrompt: Interior avenue of the Grand Bazaar with arched frescoed ceilings, hanging brass lamps, and shafts of golden sunlight beaming down. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Over four thousand shops lined sixty-four covered streets, where shafts of sunlight poured through high domed ceiling oculi.

scenes.text: Every street was segregated by guild: one alley sold only hammered copper pots, another pure Damascus silk, and another gold jewelry.
scenes.imagePrompt: Bazaar merchant shopfront displaying stacks of woven Persian kilim carpets, brass samovars, and silk scarves. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Every street was segregated by guild: one alley sold only hammered copper pots, another pure Damascus silk, and another gold jewelry.

scenes.text: Trade was impossible without ceremony: merchants invited prospective buyers onto wool divans to sip cardamom coffee and negotiate for hours.
scenes.imagePrompt: Small brass tray with miniature porcelain cups of Turkish coffee, glass water tumblers, and cubes of rosewater Turkish delight. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Trade was impossible without ceremony: merchants invited prospective buyers onto wool divans to sip cardamom coffee and negotiate for hours.

scenes.text: Guild masters maintained rigorous quality inspections: if a merchant overcharged or sold inferior cloth, his shop was padlocked shut.
scenes.imagePrompt: Heavy iron padlock secured over carved wooden cedar shop shutters with brass official guild seal wax on the frame. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Guild masters maintained rigorous quality inspections: if a merchant overcharged or sold inferior cloth, his shop was padlocked shut.
